title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.35876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning

translated_title: 基于脑电图（EEG）的癫痫发作预测的混合集成学习方法
translated_abstract: 癫痫发作预测旨在在发作开始前提供可操作的预警，然而与患者无关的泛化能力和误报控制仍然是主要挑战。我们提出了一种经过校准的混合集成模型，用于基于脑电图的癫痫发作预测，该模型通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器结合了五个深度学习模型和三个经典机器学习模型。所提出的流程集成了信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准以及基于临床需求的后处理。我们在CHB-MIT数据集上使用严格的留一患者交叉验证（LOPO）评估该框架，阈值和后处理参数仅在留出的元数据上选择。在过滤后的队列中（排除发作前期比率异常，即低于1%或高于15%的患者），该模型实现了74.2%的发作级别灵敏度，误报率为每小时1.24次，平均预警时间……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器融合五个深度学习模型和三个经典机器学习模型的校准混合集成方法，在严格的留一患者交叉验证下实现了74.2%的发作级别灵敏度和每小时1.24次误报的癫痫发作预测性能。
en_tdlr: A calibrated hybrid ensemble combining five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models via logistic regression stacking achieves 74.2% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour for patient-independent EEG-based epileptic seizure forecasting under strict Leave-One-Patient-Out validation.
